verdict.rationale: Digits documents AI-native automatic categorization of imported bank transactions: it auto-books 95%+ in real time using models trained on 170M transactions, with similarity models that remove manual expense categorization. Its bookkeeping page says the AI 'learns your business' and offers transaction flagging and smart reviews. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the user's own corrections retrain or adjust future categorizations, detail on the review/suggestion workflow for overriding categories, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
